en.shortDescription: AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI for image generation
en.longDescription:
AUTOMATIC1111 is a popular Stable Diffusion web UI for text-to-image and image-to-image generation.

Requires an NVIDIA GPU for practical use. Models persist under /data/models; outputs under /data/outputs.

de.longDescription:
